question: In India, National Epilepsy Day 2020 was celebrated on:
solution:
The correct answer is__** 17 November.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In India, National Epilepsy Day 2020 was celebrated on** 17 November.**
 
• **Epilepsy **is a chronic disorder of brain characterized by recurrent** ‘seizures’ or ‘fits’.**
 
• The seizures are caused as a result of sudden, excessive electrical discharges in the neurons (brain cells). 
 
• The condition can affect people at any age and each age group has unique concerns and problems.
